faqs.q: What is the Steel ORB Female Coupling used for?
faqs.a: The Steel ORB Female Coupling is a straight coupling in forged carbon steel with an SAE O-ring boss (ORB) (female) end and a SAE O-ring boss (ORB) (female) end. It joins two male O-ring boss ends through a short straight body, with an ORB female thread at each end.

faqs.q: How do I read part numbers such as IH-ST-6425-08-08 on the Steel ORB Female Coupling?
faqs.a: Every part number starts IH-ST-6425 and then carries one two-digit code for each end in the order the ends are named; the code is the size in sixteenths of an inch. For example IH-ST-6425-08-08 is 1/2" ORB (3/4-16) by 1/2" ORB (3/4-16); IH-ST-6425-10-10 is 5/8" ORB (7/8-14) by 5/8" ORB (7/8-14); IH-ST-6425-12-12 is 3/4" ORB (1-1/16-12) by 3/4" ORB (1-1/16-12).

faqs.q: What sizes does the Steel ORB Female Coupling come in?
faqs.a: The Steel ORB Female Coupling has 3 part numbers, with the O-ring boss end from 1/2" to 3/4" (3/4-16 to 1-1/16-12) and the other end SAE O-ring boss (ORB), 1/2" to 3/4" (3/4-16 to 1-1/16-12). The size table shows the size on each end and the dimensions in millimetres where the maker gives them.

faqs.q: How do I match the ORB size on the Steel ORB Female Coupling to my port thread?
faqs.a: Match the thread on the port, not the tube size: on this listing 1/2" ORB (3/4-16), 5/8" ORB (7/8-14) and 3/4" ORB (1-1/16-12). Measure the port thread or quote the part number and we confirm the size. The three part numbers cover 1/2", 5/8" and 3/4" ORB, with the same size at both ends.

The table's note says the values should not be taken as guaranteed minimums, so read the figure for your size.

faqs.q: Which standard does the Steel ORB Female Coupling follow?
faqs.a: On the Steel ORB Female Coupling, the O-ring boss end follows SAE J1926 / ISO 11926, a straight-thread port sealed by an O-ring under the hex, and the pressure table is the manufacturer's SAE J514 table. For a material certificate or pressure test record, ask on your RFQ and quote the part number such as IH-ST-6425-08-08, because the listing does not state one.

faqs.a: Both ends are female ORB, so it takes two male ORB ends, such as the male stud on a [Steel ORB Male × ORB Female Reducer / Expander](/p/steel-orb-male-x-orb-female-reducer-expander). Replacement O-rings are in the [O-rings for ORB and ORFS adapters](/c/adapter-o-rings).
